method: Make the filling first. Warm the tuna in spring water, drained through in the hot pan until piping hot and lightly coloured. It is already cooked, so stop before it dries out.

Keep the lettuce, tomato and other fresh/crunchy ingredients out of the pan. Mix the measured sauce or dressing with the tuna in spring water, drained; if the filling is being served hot, reduce only the sauce-coated tuna in spring water, drained until it is no longer wet enough to soak the wrap.
Warm the wrap, then layer the filling through the centre with the fresh/crunchy elements last. Do not overfill it just because you can.
Fold in the sides, roll firmly and toast seam-side down in a dry pan for 1–2 minutes if you want a crisp finish.
